prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE polished standalone landscape promotional banner, exact 16:9 aspect ratio, ideally 1920x1080 or 1536x864. This is an AI-generated fictional product test asset, not an existing brand ad. All text must be rendered perfectly as quoted; no added text, no watermark, no extra logos. Use a clear plain sans-serif resembling Arial. At least 5% safe margins. Keep logo, product image, headline, price, CTA and fine print spatially separate. Product must contain no lettering. No border or outer mockup. Design a premium minimal desk-light banner on a completely uniform solid warm ivory background #F7F2E8 (no gradient, no background texture). A stylish unbranded matte deep-teal adjustable desk lamp on the LEFT, isolated with no furniture or props, all of it inside its own rectangle. One tiny geometric symbol and the exact fictional wordmark 'LUMIQ' at upper-left, separate from lamp. On the RIGHT clean dark-teal editorial typography: headline exactly 'Light for your quiet hours.' on 2 or 3 lines. Below it price exactly 'SGD 89'. A dark-teal rounded rectangular button with white text exactly 'SHOP THE LAMP'. Bottom-right fine print exactly 'Demo offer. Lamp only.' Nothing else. Spacious intentional composition, strong readable type, product occupies roughly one third of banner. No shadows extending across the backdrop; material lighting within lamp is fine.
